desc: Prove that the minimum number of erase operations equals the number of consecutive-value components in the set of distinct values.
Derive the formula \(\sum_v \max(0,\mathrm{last}[v]-\mathrm{last}[v-1])\) for subarrays ending at each right endpoint.
Verify the constant-time updates for values \(x\) and \(x+1\), including boundaries.
Implement and validate the \(O(N)\)-time, \(O(N)\)-space Python solution.
